notes.title: The Sinister Set VR Horror Collection
notes.content:
Do you dare to overcome your fears and confront true evil as an Exorcist? Or become one of the restless undead, stuck in the afterlife? How about being deprived of your memories inside an abandoned skyscraper, or getting trapped in a dying spaceship? Maybe try to escape a haunted manor, or explore the derelict towns and run-down motels in America's deep south?

Now you get to do all this and more in [b]The Sinister Six[/b]: a bone-chilling collection of VR games no horror fan should miss!

Includes the following six titles, or the ones you do not own yet:
[list]
[b][*] The Exorcist: Legion VR (Deluxe Edition)
[*] Wraith: The Oblivion - Afterlife
[*] AFFECTED: The Manor
[*] Cosmodread
[*] Hinge
[*] A Chair in a Room: Greenwater[/b]
[/list]

Check out the bundle here:
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/22798/]https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/22798/[/url]

[previewyoutube=YyJme-7qXyU;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Bug Fixes & WMR Support Added!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30779809/aa19414b9e9580b7cab5aa692380824dc7d86d86.gif[/img]

Hello Exorcists! We just rolled out an update for all episodes yesterday.  Please make sure you download this patch before heading out on your next demonic encounter.

[b]Fixes & Improvements:[/b]
[list]
[*] An issue whereby some controllers would stop working after picking up the Holy Water in Episode 1 "First Rites" has been fixed.
[*] For those who prefer snap turn over free turning, swipe rotation on the Vive wands has been fixed.
[*] We now fully support WMR headsets and controller support has been added!
[/list]


[i]in nomine Patris et Filii et Spiritus Sancti...[/i]

notes.title: Index controllers, bug fixes, teleport improvements, etc.
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30779809/c9a217e7844eebec7f6b3c1ed6943e34406ef575.gif[/img]

Valiant Exorcists! Today we have rolled out some updates to the episodic version of The Exorcist: Legion VR.  Your feedback has been incredibly valuable.
[list]
[*] Index Controller support - Can connect index controllers at run-time without any issue.
[*] Fixed a "black screen" issue that was affecting a small number of users at start of game.
[*] Fixed bugs involving people getting permanently stuck in out of bounds.
[*] Added fail-safes for the crucifix occasionally disconnecting from the kit and becoming unusable.
[*] Fixed bug where hands would sometimes get stuck in the hover state and the player would not be able to make a fist.
[*] Improved crouching and fixed an issue where the play area marker wouldn't stay on the floor whilst smoothly crouching
[*] Improved teleport movement so players no longer have to look directly down at the floor to teleport.
[*] Fixed a retrieval issue that occasionally occurred with the secret artifact in Chapter 1 (Source of the Nile).
[/list]

For those of you who have not yet purchased any episodes, we want to let you know that we have released a Deluxe Version of the game which encompasses all FIVE chapters.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1156250/The_Exorcist_Legion_VR_Deluxe_Edition/

Happy Halloween! [i]In nomine Patris et filii et Spiritus Sancti.[/i]

notes.title: Chapter 5 Achievements Update
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30779809/aa19414b9e9580b7cab5aa692380824dc7d86d86.gif[/img]

Thanks to player feedback we were able to identify an issue which made obtaining "[i]The Tomb[/i]" achievement, (completing Chapter 5 with 100%) impossible unless done on the [u]first[/u] attempt.  That's too hard, even for us!

We've pushed out an update and Exorcists should now be able to make their way through Chapter 5 and obtain "The Tomb" achievement at any time, including 2nd and 3rd attempts. Who knows, you might just see something you missed before.

There are a total of five achievements in Chapter 5 including "[i]Lost Little Lamb[/i]", "[i]Afraid of the Dark[/i]", "[i]No Respect[/i]", "[i]Chapter 5[/i]" and "[i]The Tomb[/i]".

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30779809/19366549118a9f515301e09de33e63c28899d4d8.jpg[/img]
   
Many players have reached out to us regarding the "Puke" achievement.  We won't tell where the achievement is, but it is [u]definitely obtainable[/u], and only requires access to the police station.

notes.title: The Exorcist: Legion VR Complete Series is live!
notes.content:
[h1]THE POWER OF CHRIST COMPELS YOU![/h1]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30779809/0b9c81096abd012cc40845336815e0073d891f98.jpg[/img]

"[u]The scariest film of all time[/u]" is now the most terrifying VR experience of all time. [b]The Exorcist: Legion Complete Series[/b] is [b]now available[/b] and includes episodes "[i]First Rites[/i]", "[i]Idle Hands[/i]", "[i]Skin Deep[/i]", "[i]Samaritan[/i]" and the climax "[i]The Tomb[/i]".  You can purchase them all or finish the set if you own previous chapters.

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/5508/The_Exorcist_Legion_VR_Complete_Series_Chapters_15/

Journey through FIVE unique chapters, confront ancient Babylonian entities and discover hidden relics to upgrade your exorcism tools in each chapter. As you make your way through the shadows and hear whispers in the darkness, just keep telling yourself "it's only VR".

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30779809/f78620c928a83b3a98975964c575ee311e85e18b.png[/img]

[h1]UPDATES[/h1]

Now that we have fully launched there are several updates to the entire franchise including:
[list]
[*]Increased movement speeds for free-roam locomotion options
[*]Spanish language implementation for in-game text and dialogue subtitles
[*]Animation tweaks and improvements across all chapters
[*]Improvement to Chapter 4 artifact unlock for the Celtic Cross (have you found it?)
[*]Various bug fixes
[/list]
We hope you enjoy this adventure. [i]In nomine Patris et Filii et Spiritus[/i]...

notes.title: Chapter 4 "Samaritan" is LIVE!
notes.content:
[h1]Our longest, most immersive and (by far) most terrifying installment [b]IS NOW LIVE!![/b] [/h1]

You can purchase it directly from within the police precinct, or via the episode page here:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/740591/The_Exorcist_Legion_VR__Chapter_4_Samaritan/

[h1]A few notes as you explore the depths of the EPDF research center in Haiti:[/h1]
[list]

[*] Chapter 1 is required, and this story continues where Chapter 3 left off.

[*]This chapter requires you to [u]think[/u].  Take your time, and explore.  There are details, hints and backstory elements hidden throughout the chapter.  Some of this information might come in handy when it's time to make decisions.

[*]Use Father Bell's notebook in your inventory! The information inside is valuable.

[*]Use your phone to adjust your locomotion settings for free roam, free turning, or all manners of teleport.  Oculus  Rift users can change their settings to accommodate 360-degree tracking.

[*] When you return to the precinct at the end of the chapter, check out the evidence room.

[*][spoiler]No chickens were harmed in the making of this experience.[/spoiler]
[/list]

[i]Yea, though I walk through the valley of the shadow of death, I will fear no evil: for thou art with me; thy rod and thy staff they comfort me...[/i]

notes.title: Chapter 3 Hotfixes
notes.content:
We've implemented a few small tweaks for Chapter 3 to optimize your experience.

[list]
[*] Fix for the "Sacred Ground" artifact not properly on-boarding after discovery.
[*] Added teleport fix when users choose to teleport into the mirror world.
[*] Corrected an issue where "Little Buddy" sometimes gets stuck on the ceiling.
[*] Fix for Crucifix occasionally getting stuck in the exorcism kit during the climax.
[*] [u]Reminder:[/u] Rift users can disable the [i]"Warning: Check Orientation" [/i]message via the in-game menu if they wish to utilize full 360 degree tracking.
[/list]
Other bugs such as cockroaches and maggots are intentional.

http://store.steampowered.com/app/740590/The_Exorcist_Legion_VR__Chapter_3_Skin_Deep/

notes.title: Chapter 3 Gameplay Trailer and Release Date!
notes.content:
We've posted the new game play trailer for Chapter 3, [i]Skin Deep[/i] up on the chapter page, and set the release date for [b]January 25th![/b]... [u] just one week from today![/u]   We have been asked the meaning behind the title, but we'll leave that for you to discover.

A new artifact, new achievements, and a new demon.  Her looks can be [u]very[/u] deceiving.  Other small audio and cosmetic enhancements have been added to your office as well as the precinct. 

This chapter was very challenging from a story & technical perspective, and we're so anxious to share it with you.  

- The Exorcist: Legion VR team

store.steampowered.com/app/740590/The_Exorcist_Legion_VR__Chapter_3_Skin_Deep/
